Basecamp.persona: a project manager at a 30-person agency
Basecamp.task: I need to set up a new client project in Basecamp, including a few key to-do lists for different phases and some important documents. Then, I'll check the project's progress using a calendar view and assign some tasks to my team. Finally, I'll reorganize a to-do list and update a task's due date to reflect a change in scope.
Basecamp.core_job: Manage a client project with tasks and files.
features: Task assignment and due date management

Zoho Desk.persona: a support team lead at a 40-person software company
Zoho Desk.task: Alright team, let's get Zoho Desk set up for our customer support. I need you to create three new support tickets, assign them, and resolve them. Then, set up a custom view to track urgent issues and create a report on our weekly ticket resolution times. Finally, update one of the resolved tickets with a new internal note.

Klaviyo.persona: an e-commerce marketing manager at a small online store
Klaviyo.task: I need to set up a welcome email series for new subscribers, an abandoned cart flow, and a post-purchase follow-up. I'll create segments for each, design the emails, and then activate the flows. After that, I want to check the analytics for my welcome series and refine the segment for my abandoned cart flow to include only high-value items.
Klaviyo.core_job: Automate email marketing flows and segment customers

Freshdesk.persona: a customer support manager at a 60-person company
Freshdesk.task: As a support manager, I need to set up our Freshdesk trial to handle incoming customer issues. I'll create a few tickets for common problems, assign them, and track their resolution. Then, I'll customize a view to quickly see urgent tickets and generate a basic report on ticket volume to understand our workload.

Teamwork.com.persona: an account manager at a 25-person creative agency
Teamwork.com.task: I need to set up a new client project, 'Brand Refresh for Stellar Corp', with key phases like 'Discovery', 'Design Concepts', and 'Content Creation'. I'll add specific tasks under each, assign them to my team, and set deadlines. Then, I'll customize the project view to track progress visually and add a custom field for 'Client Priority'. Finally, I'll filter tasks to see only those due next week for a quick status update.

Bitwarden.persona: an IT admin at a 50-person company
Bitwarden.task: I need to evaluate Bitwarden for our 50-person company. I'll start by securely storing a few critical logins like our CRM, a shared social media account, and a secure note for server access. Then, I'll test its sharing capabilities by creating a collection and sharing the social media login with a team member. Finally, I'll organize these entries by adding custom fields and filtering them to see how easily I can manage our growing vault.
Bitwarden.core_job: Securely store, manage, and access company credentials.

GetResponse.persona: the marketing lead at a 20-person online course business
GetResponse.task: As the marketing lead, I need to set up a new email campaign for our upcoming 'AI for Beginners' course. I'll create a new list, import some existing leads, design a promotional email using a template, and schedule it. Then, I'll segment this list based on engagement and set up a simple automation for new sign-ups, finally reviewing the campaign's performance metrics.
GetResponse.core_job: Email campaign creation and subscriber management

Ecwid.persona: the owner of a small handmade-goods shop selling on social media
Ecwid.task: I need to get my handmade jewelry and craft items online quickly. I'll set up my Ecwid store, add a few unique products with details and photos, organize them into categories, and then customize my store's look to match my brand. Finally, I'll try to update some product details in bulk or reorganize my categories to see how flexible it is.
Ecwid.core_job: Set up store, add products, categorize, customize design.

Wrike.persona: an operations manager at a 45-person marketing agency
Wrike.task: Alright, I need to get our new 'Summer Campaign Launch' project set up in Wrike. I'll create the main project, then add three key tasks: 'Creative Brief Development', 'Ad Copywriting', and 'Media Buying'. I'll assign them to team members, set deadlines, and then use custom fields to track their status and priority. Finally, I'll generate a quick report to see our progress and reassign a task if needed.
Wrike.core_job: Project and task management for marketing campaigns

Brevo.persona: the marketing manager at a 15-person B2B SaaS startup
Brevo.task: As the marketing manager for a B2B SaaS startup, I need to set up Brevo to manage our email campaigns. I'll create three distinct email campaigns for different customer segments, including a welcome series, a feature update, and a promotional offer. Then, I'll segment our contact list based on engagement and product interest, and finally, I'll review the campaign reports to understand performance and identify areas for improvement.
Brevo.core_job: Create and send email marketing campaigns

ClickUp.persona: a product manager at a 35-person software startup
ClickUp.task: Okay, I need to set up a new project in ClickUp for our upcoming 'Feature X' development. I'll add a few key tasks, assign them, and set due dates. Then, I want to create a custom field to track 'Priority' and set up a Kanban board view to visualize progress. Finally, I'll update a task's priority and move it to a different status.
ClickUp.core_job: Manage project tasks and track progress.

Trello.persona: a team lead at a 20-person nonprofit
Trello.task: As a team lead at a 20-person nonprofit, I need to set up a Trello board to manage our upcoming 'Community Outreach Drive'. I'll create lists for 'To Do', 'In Progress', and 'Completed', then add three tasks: 'Recruit 10 volunteers', 'Design flyer', and 'Secure event venue'. After setting these up, I'll add custom fields for 'Volunteer Lead' and 'Deadline', assign deadlines, and then filter the board to see only tasks due next week. Finally, I'll move 'Design flyer' to 'In Progress' and update its deadline.
Trello.core_job: Manage project tasks and track progress.

Basecamp#2.persona: an operations coordinator at a 12-person architecture firm who tracks client deliverables and approvals
Basecamp#2.task: I need to set up a new project for our 'Acme Corp HQ Redesign' client. I'll add key deliverables like 'Initial Concept Presentation', 'Material Selection Approval', and 'Final Blueprint Sign-off'. Then, I'll organize these tasks into a clear workflow, assign them to team members, and set due dates. I also want to create a template for future client projects and then filter tasks by their approval status to see what's pending.
Basecamp#2.core_job: Manage client project deliverables and approvals.
